description: BTPS 1.1 item E, device registration bound to the identity (addendum item 3, threat T-25), and fix-list item 5 (a forged agent message). sequences: each starts from an empty token store (none when tokenStore is false) holding the tokens in `issue`, each issued `issuedMsBeforeUse` before the steps run and valid for `tokenExpiryMs`; each step is an auth.request signed over its JCS form, accepted (the device is bound to the token's identity under an agent id the server generates) or refused with `reason` and the error code `error`. In the lifecycle sequence the device is then used, refreshed with a key rotation, and its old key refused. concurrent: both requests race for one token; exactly one is accepted. forged: the store holds one enrolled device (`enrolled`) and one trust between two identities (`correspondentTrust`); each case is an agent artifact for an action other than auth.request, accepted only when it is the enrolled device's, signed by its key, to its identity.
provenance: TEST-ONLY key generated locally for the BTPS golden vectors (EBA-110). Never use it for anything else.
